vb_textbox.text: I initially found it quite difficult. It is best to pay attention to the multiplier and which side gives the best reward for that multiplier, as in general, it was consistently the same. So if the bigger amount of mushrooms was on the left for 1x multiplier, go with that each time it is 1x, whereas if it was the right for the 5x, do that each time the 5x multiplier comes up. That is what worked for me after a lot of initial trial & error.
